summary: AGRIOS Phase L (first deposit & first investment conversion) end-to-end validation. Backend 9/9 pytest PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_phase_l.py covering: (a) /api/opportunities/{id}/similar happy path (≤3 items, source excluded, no _id leak, limit param respected, 404 for unknown id, ranking returns crop/region match first), (b) regression on /api/opportunities, /api/opportunities/{id}, /api/investments/summary, /api/stats/landing-pulse — all 200 and shape valid. Frontend (Playwright against preview URL): /app/first-investment renders correctly with first-investment-page, first-invest-balance-card, pulse-signals + all 3 pulse-s-* sub-stats, 3 first-opp-* cards each with KYC verified + Escrow protected badges, explore-cta visible (wallet has balance). /app/opportunities renders 4 opp-card-* with multiple urgency badges (opp-urgent-funded-* & opp-urgent-investors-* observed; closing/remaining did not appear on this seed but logic is data-dependent). OpportunityDetail bottom shows similar-opportunities with 3 similar-* cards. WalletFundModal validated end-to-end via low-balance intercept on Rice opp (amount=1,000,000 > wallet 778k): wallet-fund-modal opens with all 3 presets (wallet-preset-10000/50000/100000 — 50k labeled Recommended), wallet-modal-presets, wallet-modal-custom-amount, wallet-trust-panel (3 trust lines + quote 'You will always see where your money is going.'), wallet-modal-fund-btn, and wallet-modal-close dismisses cleanly. CRITICAL bug found: OpportunityDetail invest gate references user.wallet_balance which backend NEVER returns on /auth/login or /auth/me, so balance is always 0 and the WalletFundModal opens for ANY invest amount — even when actual wallet balance vastly exceeds the amount. Effect: InvestmentConfirmModal and /app/investment-success redirect are UNREACHABLE via the normal happy-path on OpportunityDetail; the entire Phase L conversion funnel is broken for existing demo investor (the demo wallet balance returned in modal is ₦828,500 yet the gate still trips on a ₦50,000 invest). Because of this, confirm-amount/duration/target/payout/milestones/risk-ack and the success page testids could not be exercised end-to-end through the UI in this run.

minor.issue: limit query param has no upper bound check at FastAPI signature level; clamping happens in code (clamped to 10) but a Query(le=10, ge=1) would surface a 422 instead of silently clamping. Cosmetic.
`status` filter includes 'funded' and 'active' so closed/over-funded cycles can be recommended next to an open one. Consider returning only status=open by default for better conversion.

ui_bugs.issue: Wallet-balance gate uses user.wallet_balance from auth context, but backend /auth/login and /auth/me do NOT include wallet_balance in the user payload. Result: balance is always undefined → 0 → `0 < amount` is true for any positive amount, so WalletFundModal opens UNCONDITIONALLY when invest-submit-btn is clicked. The confirm modal and the /app/investment-success redirect become unreachable via UI for the entire happy path. This breaks the core Phase L objective ('first investment'). Repro: login as investor@agriflow.ng (real wallet 778k), open any /app/opportunities/<id>, enter ₦50,000 (< 778k, > min_ticket, < remaining), click invest-submit-btn → wallet-fund-modal opens despite sufficient balance.

After mock fund, WalletFundModal does `setUser({ ...user, wallet_balance: (user.wallet_balance || 0) + n })` which only patches React state. Refresh wipes it; and because /auth/me never returns wallet_balance, after page reload the gate trips again. Couples to the bug above.

On the current seed only opp-urgent-funded-* and opp-urgent-investors-* render. opp-urgent-closing-* (≤5d) and opp-urgent-remaining-* (<15% remaining) never trigger because seed expected_close_at is ~30d out and remaining percent never drops below 15% for the seeded opps. Not a code bug, but flag for the seeder so the conversion UX can be visually demoed.

integration_issues.issue: Cannot be exercised end-to-end through the UI due to wallet_balance gate bug above. Because of this, confirm-amount, confirm-duration, confirm-target, confirm-payout, confirm-milestones, confirm-risk-ack, confirm-allocate-btn, invest-success-page, invest-success-title, success-stat-amount, success-stat-duration, success-stat-payout, success-opp-summary (incl. 'Next update: within 7 days'), success-track-btn and success-back-to-market data-testids are all unverifiable in this iteration.

Not exercised in this run because the upstream investment-flow bug took priority. The signup wizard data-testids (signup-submit-btn, profile-continue-btn, kyc/wallet/invest-skip-btn, success-dashboard-btn) should be re-verified once the wallet_balance bug is fixed.

issues: When opened from low-balance intercept, the quote 'You will always see where your money is going.' italic line sits flush against the third trust line — a 4-6px top margin would help readability.

Toast 'Only ₦80,000 remaining' fires for over-cap inputs but on small/Tomato opps the user has no obvious affordance for what max they can invest until they submit. Inline helper showing remaining cap would reduce the wallet-fund-modal misfire confusion.

action_items: CRITICAL: Either (a) include `wallet_balance` in /api/auth/login and /api/auth/me user payload, OR (b) have OpportunityDetail fetch the live balance via /api/wallet on mount and use that for the gate. Option (b) is safer because wallet ledger is the source of truth.

After fixing the gate, re-run the InvestmentConfirmModal flow to verify confirm-amount/duration/target/payout/milestones/risk-ack render and confirm-allocate-btn POSTs to /opportunities/{id}/invest then redirects to /app/investment-success?id=&amount=&payout=.

Re-verify /app/investment-success page (invest-success-page, invest-success-title='Your capital is now at work.', success-stat-amount/duration/payout, success-opp-summary with crop/region + 'Next update: within 7 days', success-track-btn → /app/portfolio, success-back-to-market → /app/opportunities).
Re-verify post-onboarding redirect for a fresh investor signup: success-dashboard-btn label='Start your first investment' and href → /app/first-investment.
Optional: clamp limit on /opportunities/{id}/similar via FastAPI Query(ge=1, le=10) instead of silent clamp.
Optional: filter recommendations to status='open' only.
Optional: tweak seed to produce at least one opp with ≤5d remaining and one with <15% remaining capacity so opp-urgent-closing-* and opp-urgent-remaining-* badges actually surface in the demo.
critical_code_review_comments: OpportunityDetail.jsx line 90 reads `user?.wallet_balance` from AuthContext, but no backend endpoint populates this field — this is the root cause of the broken happy path. Code-review red flag: always source money/balance from a single async ledger endpoint, never from a client-cached auth profile.

WalletFundModal.jsx line 43 patches user state in-place after a mock fund but doesn't refetch /api/wallet — this creates an inconsistent UI where the modal can show ₦828,500 while the auth user object still has wallet_balance=undefined. The modal balance and the gate balance must read from the same source.

phase_h.py /opportunities/{id}/similar uses `$or` of crop/region/roi-band which is correct, but the score function inverts negative for sort. Works, but `key=lambda o: -score(o)` reading `rows.sort(key=score)` where score returns -s is double-negation that is easy to misread; consider `rows.sort(key=score, reverse=True)` with score returning +s.

InvestmentConfirmModal expects `confirm-risk-checkbox` inside `confirm-risk-ack` — the spec wording 'Tick the checkbox' should specifically reference confirm-risk-checkbox so future test scripts don't click the wrapper label. (Test had to disambiguate.)

The Phase L flow assumes both RiskAcknowledgementModal acknowledgement (persisted in localStorage) AND InvestmentConfirmModal risk-ack checkbox per investment — that's two consecutive risk gates. UX: consider hiding the second one if the user just acknowledged in the same session, or vice-versa.

rca of the issue: RCA — OpportunityDetail.invest() (lines 89-94) reads `Number(user?.wallet_balance || 0)` from AuthContext.user. The user object is populated by /api/auth/login → user payload, which (verified via curl) returns id/email/full_name/role/phone/business_name/location/kyc_status/verified/referral_code/farm_size_hectares/subscription_tier/subscription_expires_at/country/currency/created_at — NOTABLY no wallet_balance. /api/auth/me likewise omits it. Therefore balance is always 0 and the conditional `if (balance < n) setShowWalletFund(true); return;` always executes, suppressing the confirm/invest path. Repro: login investor@agriflow.ng → /app/opportunities/<rice_id> → fill 50000 → click invest-submit-btn → wallet-fund-modal opens despite displayed balance ₦828,500. Mitigation: (preferred) in OpportunityDetail useEffect, fetch /api/wallet and store balance in local state, then gate on that; alternatively, augment /api/auth/login + /api/auth/me to embed wallet_balance from db.wallets sum. Either fix unblocks confirm-modal + investment-success.
